test_title: PYST 48: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The solution is **Fluorecence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The INCORRECTLY spelt word is Fluorecence.
 
• The correct spelt word is **fluorescence**.
 
• Fluorescence - The visible or invisible radiation produced from certain substances as a result of incident radiation of a shorter wavelength such as X-rays or ultraviolet light.
 
• Therefore **option 1 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Forebear -** An ancestor.
 
• **Forgo - **Go without (something desirable).
 
• **Flounder - **Struggle or stagger clumsily in mud or water.
